description_en: Attaches an automatic snapshot policy to cloud computers. After the policy is attached, cloud computers perform automatic creation of snapshots at the times specified in the automatic snapshot policy
description_zh: 为云电脑绑定自动快照策略。绑定后，云电脑将按照自动快照策略规定的时间自动创建快照
kebab_example: aliyun ecd apply-auto-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id sp-ejtum8j5tfcw70000 --desktop-id ecd-2h7u3ymhm33qy0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer IDs. You can specify 1 to 20 IDs
parameters.name: desktop_id
